_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Forty-sixth scheduled run, and the first against the Master Trademark Filing Chart the user supplied on 2026-11-13. 16 of 22 URLs served and 10,430 product pages reviewed, a new high. Every site with a feed answered on the first attempt.

FIFTEEN MARKS MOVED PENDING -> REGISTERED on the new chart, all registered 2026-11-10: ten of Rosen Tantau KG's (Alsterwasser, Anni, Anuschka, Belle de Noir, Berliner Morgen, Berliner Sonne, Debütantin, Fontenay, Guten Morgen, Wildberry) and five of Delbard's (Chamonix, Montmartre, Pont des Arts, Rue Saint-Honoré, Velours de Nuit). Registered chart entries 19 -> 34. All fifteen registration numbers are plain seven-digit numbers and none needed flagging. Twelve of the fifteen match nothing on any seller.

THIRTEEN CASES MOVED TO REGISTERED: Montmartre 9 (HIGHGARDEN-011 and -018, KATEROSES-001, KISAKIPLAN-003, MOLAROSE-002, MUSEROSES-011, ROSEEXPLOS-018 and -026, YOURROSES-027), Wildberry 3 (HIGHGARDEN-024, ROSEEXPLOS-033, YOURROSES-033) and Anuschka 1 (ERGONGZY-001). MOLAROSE-002 keeps its Possible rating: registration does not make a bare "Montmartre Rose" title a stronger match. KATEROSES-001 is a removed listing (HTTP 404 since 2026-10-22) that is now a Registered case; its 2026-10-20 screenshot is the evidence of what it said while live.

The two malformed registration numbers flagged on 2026-11-09 are UNCHANGED in this chart -- Alexandra David Neel still reads "8,533,298)" and Monsieur "8,531, 724". Both remain Needs Review and uncorrected.

A SELLER REMOVED A CHART NAME FROM A LIVE LISTING. SPRINGLAND-008 answers HTTP 200 at the same URL and handle, but its title changed from "Royal Diva/Opera Queen 皇家迪瓦/歌剧皇后，Shrub Rose, Non-Grafted/Own Root." to "#SPJ173, Opera Queen 歌剧皇后，Shrub Rose, Non-Grafted/Own Root." -- the chart name "Royal Diva" taken out, "Opera Queen" kept. The seller's own record dates the change 2026-11-16T05:08:05-08:00, under an hour before this run read it. That is why Springland's match count fell 8 to 7 while its catalog grew 114 -> 115. Recorded as observed; the chart entry is Not Applicable and carries no enforceable right, and why the seller retitled it is theirs to say. The original title is preserved.

One new case: KISAKIPLAN-014, "Rose 'Darlington' 达林顿" (Darlington, Pending), classified POSSIBLE -- a one-word match on a name that is also an English place name. Kisaki Plant grew 357 -> 368 products. Captured the same morning.

HILLSIDERO-005 and -007 are both back after absences, the former for the eighth time since 2026-10-19. Six listings stand removed, each confirmed by HTTP 404. 452 of 464 cases verified present.

Screenshots 414 of 464. REGISTERED COVERAGE IS NOW 71 OF 75: the thirteen cases that moved today brought ten screenshots with them, and the four gaps are HIGHGARDEN-011, -018 and -024, newly Registered and awaiting the user's manual capture, plus ONELOVEROS-002 behind its membership wall.

Mola Rose and Muse Roses reported identical catalog sizes and identical match counts for the fifteenth consecutive run (791 / 48 each).
